summary_ja: リテール向けエクスポージャーのLGDの推計と区分ごとの下限(居住用不動産五パーセント等)、その他リテールの担保を勘案した下限の算式を定める。
summary_en: Sets LGD for retail exposures as an own estimate with category floors (5% residential real estate, 50% qualifying revolving, 30% other retail) and a collateral-adjusted floor formula for other retail exposures.
paragraphs: The LGD used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for retail exposures shall be an estimate, expressed as a percentage, of the ratio of the economic loss arising at default on that retail exposure or the pool to which that retail exposure belongs to EAD.

The LGD used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for retail exposures shall not be lower than the value specified in each of the following items according to the category of exposure listed in that item. (i) Residential real estate exposures: 5%. (ii) Qualifying revolving retail exposures: 50%. (iii) Other retail exposures: 30%.

Notwithstanding item (iii) of the preceding paragraph, where eligible financial collateral or eligible asset collateral has been established on an other retail exposure, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may set the floor of the estimated LGD used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for that exposure at the value, calculated by the following formula, that takes into account the effect of credit risk mitigation techniques. {{F:p178i0}} LGD_{Rfloor} is the floor of the LGD estimate applicable to other retail exposures taking into account the effect of credit risk mitigation techniques. LGD_{RUfloor} is 30%. LGD_{RSfloor} is the value set in the table of the following paragraph according to the category of collateral asset listed in that table.

Where the formula in the preceding paragraph is used, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall use, as LGD_{RSfloor}, the value specified in the lower column of the following table according to the category of collateral asset listed in that table. {{T:p178t0}}

The provisions of Article 133, paragraph (5) shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach takes into account the effect of credit risk mitigation techniques of collateral in the LGD floor under paragraph (3). In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach" in paragraph (5) of that Article shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach", "paragraph (3)" as "Article 141, paragraph (3)", and "corporate, etc. exposure" as "other retail exposure".
